title: An affine elementary etale finite locally free multisection of a nonempty fibre
statement: Let $S$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $h:Y\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and of finite presentation, meaning locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Suppose each fibre $Y_t$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically reduced over $\kappa(t)$ [def-weil-residue-field, def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Let $s\in S$ satisfy $Y_s\ne\varnothing$. There exist an affine scheme $U$, an etale morphism $a:U\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $u\in U$ with $a(u)=s$ inducing an isomorphism $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(u)$, a scheme $E$, a finite locally free morphism $p:E\to U$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free], and a morphism $\sigma:E\to Y_U=Y\times_S U$ [def-pc-fibre-product] such that $h_U\circ\sigma=p$, where $h_U:Y_U\to U$ is the projection. The fibre $E_u$ has exactly one point. Moreover $h_U$ is flat and of finite presentation with geometrically reduced fibres, $(Y_U)_u\simeq Y_s\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(u)$ canonically, and if $Y_s$ is geometrically connected then $(Y_U)_u$ is geometrically connected (connected includes nonempty [def-weil-connected-scheme]).

source.place: Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, proof, second paragraph: closed Cohen–Macaulay point, flat quasi-finite slice, elementary-etale finite piece, affine refinement, finite local freeness and base-changed fibre checks (old item steps 4–7)

proof.text: The fibre Y_s is locally of finite type over its residue field: local finite presentation implies local finite type and this persists under base change [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Apply Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian to its structure morphism and the Mathlib stalk instance to obtain Noetherianity of every fibre stalk [pqf-def-locnoeth]. No hypothesis on the base being Noetherian is used. These are the instances in exists_closed_cm_fibre_point.

source.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, second paragraph, hypotheses for choosing a closed Cohen–Macaulay fibre point; locally Noetherian fibres as in Tag 045U.

proof.text: Take the inverse image under the fibre inclusion of the open relative depth-equals-dimension locus [lem-sbc-fibre-cohen-macaulay-locus-open]. The elementary helper fibre_cm_iff identifies it with the intrinsic depth-equals-dimension locus C in Y_s: substitute the equality of base points and use injectivity of the fibre inclusion to identify asFiber with the chosen fibre point. Apply [lem-trf-flat-lfp-cm-locus-fibre-dense] to the whole nonempty fibre to see C is nonempty. The fibre is Jacobson by [lem-sc-lft-over-field-jacobson-space], so its nonempty open C contains a closed point. Step 1 supplies Noetherianity at that closed point. This completes exists_closed_cm_fibre_point.

source.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, second paragraph: pick a closed Cohen–Macaulay fibre point; Tag 045U, lemma-flat-finite-presentation-CM-open, parts (1)–(3).

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-cm-closed-point-flat-quasifinite-slice] at the closed Cohen-Macaulay fibre point to obtain i:Z -> Y, with f=i followed by h flat and locally of finite presentation and a distinguished singleton fibre. Local finite presentation implies local finite type [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. The singleton fibre is subsingleton, hence discrete; after transporting the base point equality, the singleton at f.asFiber x is open for x the image of its unique point. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-local-finite-at-point-elementary] to obtain an elementary etale neighbourhood (U0,a0,u0), and an open V in Z times_S U0 finite over U0 with its unique point v over u0, its projection to x, and the specified residue-field isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, second paragraph: apply Tag 0570, lemma-slice-CM, then Tag 02LK, lemma-etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-at-point.

proof.text: Choose the member j:U -> U0 of the affine open cover containing u0, and its preimage point u [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. Define a=j followed by a0 and define pi:Z times_S U -> Z times_S U0 by pullback.map, with both projection equations. Etaleness of a follows by composition [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. The residue-field map for j is an isomorphism, so Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp and the equality j(u)=u0 give the residue-field isomorphism for a. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-elementary-etale-finite-piece-persistence] to V,v,j,u and pi, with all hypotheses supplied by the previous step. It gives finiteness of p:E -> U for E=pi inverse-image V and a unique point vprime over u. The fibre homeomorphism gives nonemptiness of p.fiber u, and injectivity of its fibre inclusion together with uniqueness of vprime gives subsingletonness.

source.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, affine elementary-etale refinement; Tag 02LK, lemma-etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-at-point, final assertion.

proof.text: Flatness and local finite presentation of f persist under base change and composition with the open inclusion of E [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change, lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Together with finiteness from step 4 these are precisely the fields of Scheme.Hom.IsFiniteLocallyFree [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. Define sigma as the inclusion E -> Z times_S U followed by pullback.map induced by i:Z -> Y [def-pc-base-change]. The pullback projection equations prove sigma followed by the second projection equals p.

source.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, second paragraph: flat locally finitely presented finite piece is finite locally free; the equivalence of Tag 02KB, lemma-finite-flat, is already the definition in def-pc-finite-locally-free.

proof.text: Flatness, local finite presentation, quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of h persist under base change [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change, lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence]. Mathlib isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback gives the cartesian fibre square over each residue-field map [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-base-change]. Geometric reducedness and geometric connectedness transport through that square by MorphismProperty.of_isPullback [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. In baseChange_fibre_iso, substitute a(u)=s, use this square's isoPullback, and compose its first projection identity with the old fibre inclusion to obtain exactly the two required canonical equations. Thus no noncanonical identification of fibres is used.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_etale_finiteLocallyFree_multisection {Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] (h : Y ⟶ S) [Flat h] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation h] [QuasiCompact h] [QuasiSeparated h] (hred : ∀ t : S, GeometricallyReduced (h.fiberToSpecResidueField t)) (s : S) (hs : Nonempty (h.fiber s)) : ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (a : U ⟶ S) (u : U) (hu : a u = s), IsAffine U ∧ Etale a ∧ IsIso (a.residueFieldMap u) ∧ ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (p : E ⟶ U) (σ : E ⟶ pullback h a), Scheme.Hom.IsFiniteLocallyFree p ∧ σ ≫ pullback.snd h a = p ∧ Nonempty (p.fiber u) ∧ Subsingleton (p.fiber u) ∧ Flat (pullback.snd h a) ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (pullback.snd h a) ∧ QuasiCompact (pullback.snd h a) ∧ QuasiSeparated (pullback.snd h a) ∧ (∀ v : U, GeometricallyReduced ((pullback.snd h a).fiberToSpecResidueField v)) ∧ (∃ e : (pullback.snd h a).fiber u ≅ pullback (h.fiberToSpecResidueField s) (Spec.map ((S.residueFieldCongr hu).inv ≫ a.residueFieldMap u)), e.hom ≫ pullback.fst (h.fiberToSpecResidueField s) (Spec.map ((S.residueFieldCongr hu).inv ≫ a.residueFieldMap u)) ≫ h.fiberι s = (pullback.snd h a).fiberι u ≫ pullback.fst h a ∧ e.hom ≫ pullback.snd (h.fiberToSpecResidueField s) (Spec.map ((S.residueFieldCongr hu).inv ≫ a.residueFieldMap u)) = (pullback.snd h a).fiberToSpecResidueField u) ∧ (GeometricallyConnected (h.fiberToSpecResidueField s) → GeometricallyConnected ((pullback.snd h a).fiberToSpecResidueField u))
